In the following Ignition Working Conditions:
the user can manage  the vehicle setup menu through TLM_Display.GUI.
WHEN the Ignition Working Conditions switches from "Ignition On" OR "Ignition Start" OR "Ignition On Engine On" to  the following Ignition Working Condition:
THEN TLM shall store the last setup settings.
WHEN the Ignition Working Conditions switches from "Ignition Off" to  the following Ignition Working Condition:
THEN TLM shall wait to receive the "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP" AND  "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2 AND IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP3 AND IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP4" message
WHEN TLM receive the first "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP" message in "Ignition On" OR "Ignition On Engine On" Ignition Working Condition
Update the "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP" message to the "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP" message ( as defined in each item menu paragraph);
WHEN TLM receive the first "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2" message in "Ignition On" OR "IgnitionOn Engine On Ignition" Working Condition
Update the "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2" message to the "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2" message ( as defined in each item menu paragraph);
WHEN TLM receive the first "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP3" message in "Ignition On" OR "IgnitionOn Engine On Ignition" Working Condition
Update the "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3" message to the "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP3" message ( as defined in each item menu paragraph);
WHEN TLM receive the first "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP4" message in "Ignition On" OR "Ignition On Engine On" Ignition Working Condition
Update the "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP4" message to the "IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP4" message ( as defined in each item menu paragraph);
In the following Ignition Working Conditions:
the user can manage  the service setup menu and the Power Level menu through TLM_Display.GUI.
The items menu are as follows:
IF"Cornering_Light" PROXI parameter is equal to "absent"
THENTLM shall not display the Cornering Light menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF"Cornering_Light" PROXI parameter is equal to "present"
THENTLM shall display the Cornering Light menu item and the user can perform setting.
IFthe user sets "Cornering_Enable.Req" internal signals to "Enable"
THENTLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.CorneringEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "True" and sends this signal to IPC
IFthe user sets "Cornering_Enable.Req" internal signals as "Not_Enable"
THENTLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.CorneringEnable_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "False" and sends this signal to IPC
THEN TLM updates the Cornering information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
For more details refer to VF230 and VF033
IF"Greeting_Lights_Menù" PROXI parameter is equal to "Absent"
THENTLM shall not display the Greeting Light menu item and the user can not perform any setting.
IF"Greeting_Lights_Menù" PROXI parameter is equal to "Present"
THENTLM shall display the Greeting Light menu item and the user can perform setting.
IFthe user sets "GreetingLights_Enable.Req" internal signals to "0 sec"
THENTLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP4.GreetingLightsLevel_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "0 sec" and sends this signal to IPC
IFthe user sets "GreetingLights_Enable.Req" internal signals to "30 sec"

IFthe user sets "GreetingLights_Enable.Req" internal signals to "90 sec"
THENTLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP4.GreetingLightsLevel_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "90 sec" and sends this signal to IPC
THEN TLM updates the Greeting Lights information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF       the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Early"

IF       the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Late"

IF           "Half_Torque_Sensibility" PROXI parameter is equal to "Level 2"

IF       the user sets "LDW_Sensibility_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Late"
THEN    TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Sensibility_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Late" and sends this signal to IPC
THEN TLM updates the LDW Sensibility information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF           "Half_HMI_Setting" PROXI parameter is equal to "Level 3"
THENTLM shall display the " Lanse Sense Strenght 1 "    menu item and the user can perform setting  with the following options:
IF       the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Low"

THEN    TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "High" and sends this signal to IPC
THEN TLM updates the LDW Sensibility information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal
IF           "Half_HMI_Setting" PROXI parameter is equal to "Level 2"

IF       the user sets "LDW_Intensity_Setting.Req" internal signals to "Low"
THEN    TLM shall set "TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.LDW_Intensity_Req" B-CAN signal equal to "Low" and sends this signal to IPC

THEN TLM updates the LDW Sensibility information on its display through "TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info" internal signal

IF"Side_Distance_Warning"  PROXI parameter is equal to "Present"
